snippet.title: CURE - A Hospital Simulator | Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Manage the night-shift ER during the apocalypse, solo or with friends online: diagnose patients, design and grow your hospital, and defend against the undead while treating the living. Integrate with Twitch chat for even more fun!
Early Access available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2786550/CURE__A_Hospital_Simulator/
